'''2008 Norwegian Open''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG mini-open, announced as the "Norwegian Open Championship 2008", played on Sunday 8 June 2008 near Oslo, Norway.<ref name="sf-20492-295774">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=295774#p295774 Norwegian Open Championship 2008 (June 8th)], Thomas Caspersen, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (24 April 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181259/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20492.html Internet Archive]</ref> Four players took part. [[Angelo Consoli]] won and took the trophy home; without him travelling to the event it would have been cancelled.<ref name="sf-20492-307400">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307400#p307400 Norwegian Open Championship 2008 (June 8th)], Thomas Caspersen, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181259/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20492.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-20492-307224">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307224#p307224 Norwegian Open Championship 2008 (June 8th)], Gravityshadow (Angelo Consoli), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181259/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20492.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' near Oslo; announced for Sandvika with fewer than seven players and for Pizza Hut Nydalen with seven or more, both about ten minutes from Oslo<ref name="sf-20492-295774" />
* '''Dates:''' 8 June 2008<ref name="sf-20492-295774" />
* '''Time:''' 11 am<ref name="sf-20492-295774" />
* '''Format:''' mini-open (one bye), constructed, six rounds, no final confrontation<ref name="sf-20492-295774" />
* '''Entry fee:''' 100 NOK; free for players from abroad<ref name="sf-20492-295774" />
* '''Tournament director:''' Christian Caspersen, with a three-judge system<ref name="sf-20492-295774" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Angelo Consoli]]<ref name="sf-20492-307400" />

== Organization ==

[[Thomas Caspersen]] announced the event on 24 April 2008, marked "Pending approval". He planned to buy one of the Players Committee's Ultimate packages, so the winner would receive a virtual card design and glass, and every player would get boosters. He offered free accommodation to the first three players who asked.<ref name="sf-20492-295774" />

== Results ==

Caspersen posted the final results on 14 June 2008:<ref name="sf-20492-307400" />

{| class="wikitable"
|+ Full standings (4 players)
! # !! Player !! Points (differential) !! Light Side deck !! Dark Side deck
|-
| 1 || [[Angelo Consoli]] || 10 (+120) || Profit || BHBM
|-
| 2 || Christian Caspersen || 6 (−7) || DBO || BHBM
|-
| 3 || [[Thomas Caspersen]] || 5 (+23) || TRM || BHBM
|-
| 4 || [[Magnus Kristiansen]] || 0 (−136) || Farming || BHBM
|}

All four players played Bring Him Before Me as their Dark Side deck. Caspersen wrote that the event would have been cancelled had Consoli not come.<ref name="sf-20492-307400" /> Consoli, who posted as Gravityshadow, thanked Caspersen for the accommodation; it was his first time in Oslo, and he took the trophy home.<ref name="sf-20492-307224" /> The list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids that Cedric (simone89) posted gives "June 8th Norwegian Open Championship 2008 Angelo Consoli".<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
